acceptanceCriteria: Either interpreter matching at load considers only literal text that stands alone as the program name, with the rendered value left to the ATR-V0-133 launch recheck, or the ATR spec states this conservative refusal explicitly
A test covers {ticketLocal}sh; focused dispatch tests pass
body: Found in V1-1852 (#1157, PR #1160). promptSafeHost runs argvCodeRisk on each argv element with its placeholders removed. An element like {ticketLocal}sh leaves the literal text sh, which matches the interpreter list, so the config is refused at load even though a ticket local of t1 renders t1sh, which is safe. Conservative (refuses safe shapes), not unsafe.
title: Dispatch load-time host check on literal text with placeholders stripped is conservative: {ticketLocal}sh is refused as the interpreter sh
